people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
translations.bsb: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
translations.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
